title: The Rent Went Up
setting: A shared two-bed terraced house on Ashgrove Road, Leeds, UK; 24–31 January 2026.
premise: Priya is convinced her roommate Callum is quietly scamming her on rent — until she finds out he has spent four months secretly paying the landlord's increase on her behalf.
synopsis: A puzzling thank-you from their landlord sends Priya down a trail of half-truths: Callum collects her rent, dodges every question and lies about a boiler. Egged on by her sister, Priya demands answers in the house group chat — and learns exactly what Callum has been hiding, and why.

characters.name: Priya Nair
characters.description: Pharmacy technician whose hours were cut in October. Proud, organised, hates owing anyone. Texts in full sentences with full stops; no emoji when upset.

characters.name: Callum Reid
characters.description: Freelance live-sound engineer. Kind, conflict-avoidant, a bad liar. Lowercase, lots of 'ha', deflects with jokes.

characters.name: Anjali Nair
characters.description: Paralegal. Protective and quick to escalate. Rapid short bursts, CAPS for emphasis, 👀.

characters.name: Dave Whitlock
characters.description: Decent, old-fashioned small landlord. Ellipses, thumbs-up, signs off 'Regards, Dave'.

relationships.description: Met at university; have shared 14 Ashgrove Road for three years. Platonic.
Anjali is protective and has never liked Callum's 'vibe'.
Dave likes Callum, who handles house admin.

centralConflict: Priya's pride and fear of being taken advantage of against Callum's well-meant secrecy: the more he hides, the guiltier he looks.

secrets.description: Rent rose from £1,050 to £1,190 a month from 1 October 2025 (letter given to Callum).
Callum has paid Priya's £70 share of the increase since October and asked Dave not to mention the figure, telling him Priya 'would prefer' it.
Callum claimed the 'top-up' was a boiler callout; there was none.
Callum asked Dave for a reference for a one-bed on Hyde Park Road in November, then withdrew to stay.

plotOutline.title: Thanks for Sorting January
beats: Dave thanks Priya for a 'top-up' she never paid
Callum blames a boiler callout and dodges the new lease
Anjali plants suspicion; Callum postpones the pub chat
Dave: Callum said Priya would prefer he didn't mention 'the new amount'

plotOutline.title: The House Chat
beats: Anjali's theory: rent went down and Callum pockets the difference
Dave: no boiler callout; Callum got 'the letter' in October
Priya asks in the house group what the rent actually is

plotOutline.title: The New Amount
beats: Dave forwards Callum's October message and mentions Hyde Park Road
Public apology, repayment plan, lease signed, Anjali's verdict

plannedEnding: Reconciliation with consequences: Priya apologises publicly in the house chat, insists on repaying £280 at £70 a month once her full hours return, and they renew the lease together. Anjali texts Callum for the first time: 'fine. you're alright.'
continuity: Old rent £1,050 (£525 each); from 1 Oct 2025 £1,190 (£595 each). Callum paid £665/month Oct–Jan.
Since October Priya sends her £525 to Callum (ref RENT), who pays Dave in one payment.
Priya's hours were cut the first week of October; full hours return Monday 2 February 2026.
Repayment: £280 total, £70/month for four months, plus Priya does the bins. From February Priya pays £595 directly to Dave.
New 12-month lease signed 31 January 2026; Dave collects it Monday 2 February.
Callum skipped the Christmas Edinburgh trip with Priya (money, not work).
Anjali has Callum's number and texted him for the first time on 31 January.

timeline.event: Rent rises to £1,190; Callum starts covering Priya's extra £70.
Callum asks Dave not to mention the new figure to Priya.
Callum asks Dave for a Hyde Park Road reference, then withdraws.
Dave confirms there was no boiler callout.
Priya asks the house group what the rent is.

unresolvedThreads.description: What is the 'top-up' Callum sends Dave?
Why is there a new lease, and why hasn't Priya seen it?
Can Priya and Callum's friendship survive the public accusation?

partSummaries.title: Thanks for Sorting January
partSummaries.summary: Dave thanks Priya for a rent 'top-up' she never paid. Callum blames a boiler callout, says he's read a new lease she hasn't seen, and keeps postponing a chat. Anjali smells a scam. Then Dave apologises for raising 'the new amount', saying Callum told him Priya would prefer he didn't.

partSummaries.title: The House Chat
partSummaries.summary: Anjali decides the rent went down and Callum is pocketing the difference. Dave confirms there was never a boiler callout and that Callum got 'the letter' in October. Callum begs to talk in person, then cancels twice. Priya takes Anjali's advice and asks the house group chat — landlord included — what the rent actually is.

partSummaries.title: The New Amount
partSummaries.summary: Dave reveals the rent rose to £1,190 in October. Callum admits he's been covering Priya's extra £70 since the week her hours were cut. Dave forwards Callum's October message and mentions the flat Callum gave up. After hours of silence Priya apologises — to Callum and publicly — insists on a repayment plan, and they sign the new lease. Anjali finally gives Callum her verdict.
